akhfash:1-1.t:
He said ﴿أُوْلِيۤ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلاَثَ وَرُبَاعَ﴾: he did not make it fully declinable (it is a diptote) because "الثَلاثَةَ" (three) and "الأرْبَعَةَ" (four) were felt to be implied in it. This is used only in the case of number. In another place He said ﴿أَن تَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَادَىٰ﴾, and you say "ادْخُلوا أُحادَ أُحادَ" (enter one by one) as you say "ثُلاثَ ثُلاثَ" (three by three). The poet said [in the wāfir metre; this is poetic witness no. 162]:
أحمَّ اللهُ ذَلِكَ من لِقاءِ * أُحادَ أُحَادَ في شَهْرٍ حلال
(May Allah bring about that meeting, one on one, in a month when fighting is lawful.)

akhfash:2-2.t: And He said ﴿مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلاَ مُمْسِكَ لَهَا﴾: He used the feminine because "mercy" was mentioned; ﴿وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلاَ مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ﴾: He used the masculine because the word ﴿ما﴾ is treated as masculine.

akhfash:18-18.t:
And He said ﴿وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ﴾ (accusative) because it is a khabar (predicate).
And He said ﴿وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا﴾: it is as though He said "and if she calls a person, he will not carry anything of her burden, even if the person were a near relative".

akhfash:21-21.t: And He said ﴿وَلاَ ٱلظِّلُّ وَلاَ ٱلْحَرُورُ﴾: it seems that ﴿لا﴾ is redundant (zāʾida), because if you said "لا يَسْتَوِى عَمْرٌو ولا زَيْدٌ" (ʿAmr and Zayd are not equal) in this meaning, it could only be that ﴿لا﴾ is redundant.

akhfash:27-27.t:
And He said ﴿وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ﴾: the singular of "الجُدَدُ" is "جُدَّةٌ"; "الجُدَدِ" are the colours of the streaks in them, like "الغُدَّة" (gland), whose plural is "الغُدَدُ". Were it the plural of "الجَديدِ" (new) it would be "الجُدُد". It was read ﴿مُخْتَلِفاً أَلْوَانُها﴾ only because every attribute placed first runs on what precedes it when it is connected with it (sababī); so "the fruits" are in the position of the accusative.
And He said ﴿وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا﴾ and put "المُخْتَلِفُ" in the nominative because what precedes it is nominative.

akhfash:31-31.t: And He said ﴿هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقاً﴾ (accusative) because "the truth" is definite.

akhfash:36-36.t: And He said ﴿وَلاَ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا﴾, whereas He said ﴿كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَاهُمْ سَعِيراً﴾: He means "it will not be lightened for them from the punishment that is thus".

akhfash:41-41.t: And He said ﴿ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولاَ [وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ] إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا﴾: He used the dual, whereas He had said ﴿ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ﴾, which is a plural. I think — and Allah knows best — that He made the heavens one kind, like a single thing.

akhfash:42-42.t: And He said ﴿لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلأُمَمِ﴾: He made it "إِحْدَى" (feminine "one") because it is a nation (أمّة).

akhfash:45-45.t: And He said ﴿وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ﴾: He implied the earth without its having been mentioned, because this expression has become so frequent that its meaning is known. You say: "أُخْبِرُكَ ما على ظَهْرِهَا أَحَدٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ منكَ وما بِهَا أحَدٌ آثَرُ عِنْدِي مِنْكَ" (I tell you, there is no one on its back dearer to me than you, and no one in it more preferred by me than you).

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ Allah the Exalted praised Himself with this, as was explained at the beginning of Sabaʾ ﴿فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ their Creator without any previous model ﴿جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا﴾ to the prophets ﴿أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ﴾ among the angels and others ﴿مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ﴾ such as provision and rain ﴿فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ﴾ of that ﴿فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ i.e. after His withholding it ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ prevailing over His affair ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His action

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾ i.e. people of Mecca ﴿اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ by settling you in the Sanctuary and preventing raids against you ﴿هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ﴾ «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida) and «خَالِقٍ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿غَيْرُ اللَّهِ﴾ in the nominative and the genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of «خَالِقٍ» in its wording and in its position, and the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is ﴿يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾ the rain ﴿وَ﴾ from ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ the plants; and the interrogative is for affirmation (taqrīr), i.e. there is no creator and provider other than He ﴿لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ from where are you turned away from His oneness, while you acknowledge that He is the Creator, the Provider?

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ﴾ O Muhammad, in your bringing [the message of] oneness, the resurrection, the reckoning and the punishment ﴿فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ in that; so be patient as they were patient ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ﴾ in the Hereafter, and He will recompense the deniers and help the messengers

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ﴾ of the resurrection and other things ﴿حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا﴾ away from believing in that ﴿وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ﴾ in His forbearance and His granting respite ﴿الْغَرُورُ﴾ Satan

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا﴾ by obeying Allah, and do not obey him ﴿إِنَّمَا يَدْعُو حِزْبَهُ﴾ his followers in disbelief ﴿لِيَكُونُوا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ﴾ the intense Fire

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾ this is an explanation of what belongs to those who go along with Satan and what belongs to those who oppose him; and it was revealed concerning Abū Jahl and others

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ﴾ by deceptive embellishment ﴿فَرَآهُ حَسَنًا﴾ «مَنْ» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is "like one whom Allah has guided?" No; [this omitted khabar] is indicated by ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ over those for whom [their deeds] have been made to seem fair ﴿حَسَرَاتٍ﴾ by your grieving that they do not believe ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ﴾ and He will recompense them for it

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ﴾ and in one reading [الرِّيحَ] ﴿فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا﴾ the imperfect is for relating a past state (ḥikāyat al-ḥāl al-māḍiya), i.e. stirs it up ﴿فَسُقْنَاهُ﴾ in it there is a shift (iltifāt) from the third person ﴿إِلَى بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ﴾ with and without doubling [of the yāʾ]: having no plants ﴿فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ﴾ of the land ﴿بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا﴾ its dryness, i.e. We made crops and pasture grow by it ﴿كَذَلِكَ النُّشُورُ﴾ i.e. the resurrection and bringing to life

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا﴾ in this world and the Hereafter, and it is not obtained from Him except through obeying Him, so let him obey Him ﴿إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ﴾ He knows it; and it is «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ» and the like ﴿وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ﴾ accepts it ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ﴾ the plots ﴿السَّيِّئَاتِ﴾ against the Prophet in Dār al-Nadwa, of binding him, killing him or expelling him, as was mentioned in al-Anfāl ﴿لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ أُولَئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ﴾ perishes

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ﴾ by creating your father Adam from it ﴿ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ i.e. semen, by creating his offspring from it ﴿ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا﴾ males and females ﴿وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. known to Him ﴿وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِنْ مُعَمَّرٍ﴾ i.e. nothing is added to the life of one with a long life ﴿وَلَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ﴾ i.e. of that long-lived one, or of another long-lived one ﴿إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ﴾ it is the Preserved Tablet ﴿إِنَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ﴾ easy.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ﴾ very sweet ﴿سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ﴾ its drinking ﴿وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ﴾ very salty ﴿وَمِنْ كُلٍّ﴾ of the two ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا﴾ it is fish ﴿وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ﴾ from the salt one, and it is said: from both ﴿حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا﴾ it is pearls and coral ﴿وَتَرَى﴾ you see ﴿الْفُلْكَ﴾ the ships ﴿فِيهِ﴾ in each of the two ﴿مَوَاخِرَ﴾ ploughing the water, i.e. cleaving it as they run in it, going forth and coming back with one and the same wind ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ to seek ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ the Exalted's [bounty], through trade ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ Allah for that

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿يُولِجُ﴾ makes enter ﴿اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ﴾ and so it increases ﴿وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ and so it increases ﴿وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ﴾ of the two ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ in its orbit ﴿لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ the Day of Resurrection ﴿ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ﴾ worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, and they are the idols ﴿مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ﴾ the thin skin of the date stone

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿إِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا﴾ hypothetically ﴿مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ﴾ they would not answer you ﴿وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ﴾ your associating them with Allah, i.e. they will disown you and your worship of them ﴿وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ﴾ of the states of the two abodes ﴿مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ﴾ He is Allah the Exalted

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ in every state ﴿وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ﴾ free of need of His creation ﴿الْحَمِيدُ﴾ praised in what He does for them

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾ in place of you

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَلَا تَزِرُ﴾ a soul ﴿وَازِرَةٌ﴾ sinful, i.e. does not bear ﴿وِزْرَ﴾ a soul ﴿أُخْرَى وَإِنْ تَدْعُ﴾ a soul ﴿مُثْقَلَةٌ﴾ with burden ﴿إِلَى حِمْلِهَا﴾ of it, anyone, to bear some of it ﴿لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ﴾ the one called upon ﴿ذَا قُرْبَى﴾ kinship, such as the father and the son; and the not bearing in both cases is a ruling from Allah ﴿إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ i.e. they fear Him though they have not seen Him, because they are the ones who benefit from the warning ﴿وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَوةَ﴾ kept it up ﴿وَمَنْ تَزَكَّى﴾ purifies himself of idolatry and other things ﴿فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّى لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ so his righteousness is specific to him ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ﴾ the return, and He recompenses deeds in the Hereafter.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ the disbeliever and the believer

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ﴾ Paradise and the Fire

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ﴾ the believers nor the disbelievers; and the addition of «لَا» in the three is for tawkīd (emphasis) ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ his guidance, and he answers Him with faith ﴿وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers; He likened them to the dead, so that they would answer

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿أَنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ﴾ a warner to them

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with guidance ﴿بَشِيرًا﴾ [to] whoever responds to it ﴿وَنَذِيرًا﴾ [to] whoever does not respond to it ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا﴾ passed ﴿فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ﴾ a prophet warning it

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ﴾ the miracles ﴿وَبِالزُّبُرِ﴾ such as the Scrolls of Abraham ﴿وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ﴾ it is the Torah and the Gospel; so be patient as they were patient

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ for their denial ﴿فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ﴾ My disapproval of them through punishment and destruction, i.e. it fell in its proper place

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ know ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا﴾ in it there is a shift (iltifāt) from the third person ﴿بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا﴾ such as green, red, yellow and others ﴿وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ﴾ plural of judda, a track in a mountain and elsewhere ﴿بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ﴾ and yellow ﴿مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا﴾ in intensity and faintness ﴿وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ﴾ conjoined to «جُدَدٌ», i.e. rocks of intense blackness; one often says «أَسْوَدُ غِرْبِيبٌ», and rarely «غِرْبِيبٌ أَسْوَدُ»

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذَلِكَ﴾ like the variety of fruits and mountains ﴿إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ﴾ unlike the ignorant, such as the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ﴾ in His dominion ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ of the sins of His believing servants

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ﴾ recite ﴿كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَوةَ﴾ kept it up ﴿وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً﴾ as zakat and otherwise ﴿يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ﴾ perish

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ﴾ the reward of their deeds mentioned ﴿وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ﴾ of their sins ﴿شَكُورٌ﴾ of their obedience

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Qur'an ﴿هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ﴾ the scriptures that preceded it ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾ knowing the inward and the outward

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا﴾ We gave ﴿الْكِتَابَ﴾ the Qur'an ﴿الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا﴾ and they are your community ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ by falling short in acting upon it ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ﴾ who acts upon it most of the time ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ﴾ who adds to acting [upon it] teaching and guiding [others] to act ﴿بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾ by His will ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. their being given the Book as inheritance ﴿هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ﴾

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ﴾ of permanent residence ﴿يَدْخُلُونَهَا﴾ the three [groups]; with the verb active and passive; the khabar (predicate) of «جَنَّاتُ», the mubtadaʾ (subject) ﴿يُحَلَّوْنَ﴾ a second khabar ﴿فِيهَا﴾ ﴿مِنْ﴾ some ﴿أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤٍ﴾ set with gold; [also read وَلُؤْلُؤًا] ﴿وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ﴾ all of it ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ﴾ of sins ﴿شَكُورٌ﴾ of obedience

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿الَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ﴾ i.e. of residence ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ﴾ toil ﴿وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ﴾ exhaustion from toil, because there is no religious obligation (taklīf) in it; and the mention of the second, which follows from the first, is to state its negation explicitly

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ with death ﴿فَيَمُوتُوا﴾ and find rest ﴿وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا﴾ for the blink of an eye ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ as We have recompensed them ﴿يُجْزَى كُلُّ كَفُورٍ﴾ disbeliever; with yāʾ, and with nūn vowelled with fatḥa together with kasra on the zāy and «كُلَّ» in the accusative [نَجْزِي كُلَّ]

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا﴾ calling for help with vehemence and wailing, saying: ﴿رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا﴾ from it ﴿نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ﴾ and it will be said to them: ﴿أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا﴾ a time ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ﴾ the Messenger, and you did not respond ﴿فَذُوقُوا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the disbelievers ﴿مِنْ نَصِيرٍ﴾ who would repel the punishment from them

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ﴾ of what is in the hearts; so His knowledge of other things is all the more fitting, in view of the state of people.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ plural of khalīfa, i.e. some of you succeed others ﴿فَمَنْ كَفَرَ﴾ among you ﴿فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ﴾ i.e. the evil consequence of his disbelief ﴿وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا﴾ anger ﴿وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا﴾ for the Hereafter

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ﴾ worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, and they are the idols which you claimed to be partners of Allah the Exalted ﴿أَرُونِي﴾ tell me ﴿مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ﴾ a partnership with Allah ﴿فِي﴾ the creation of ﴿السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَى بَيِّنَتٍ﴾ a proof ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ that they have a partnership with Me? None of that! ﴿بَلْ إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ the disbelievers ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا﴾ falsehood, by their saying that the idols intercede for them

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولَا﴾ i.e. He prevents them from ceasing ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ a lām of oath ﴿زَالَتَا إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿أَمْسَكَهُمَا﴾ would hold them ﴿مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ other than He ﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا﴾ in delaying the punishment of the disbelievers

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَأَقْسَمُوا﴾ the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ﴾ with the utmost of their effort in them ﴿لَئِنْ جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ﴾ a messenger ﴿لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَى مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ﴾ the Jews, the Christians and others, i.e. any one of them, because they saw them belying one another, since the Jews said "The Christians have nothing [to stand on]" and the Christians said "The Jews have nothing [to stand on]" ﴿فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ﴾ Muhammad ﷺ ﴿مَا زَادَهُمْ﴾ his coming ﴿إِلَّا نُفُورًا﴾ distancing from guidance

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿اسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ from faith; a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) ﴿وَمَكْرَ﴾ the deed ﴿السَّيِّئِ﴾ of idolatry and other things ﴿وَلَا يَحِيقُ﴾ encompasses ﴿الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ﴾ and that is the plotter. Describing «الْمَكْرُ» with «السَّيِّئُ» is the original [usage], and its being annexed to it before is another usage in which a muḍāf is implied, to avoid annexation to the adjective ﴿فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ wait for ﴿إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ Allah's practice concerning them, of punishing them for denying their messengers ﴿فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا﴾ i.e. the punishment is not replaced by something else, nor is it diverted to someone not deserving it

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً﴾ and Allah destroyed them for denying their messengers ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ that would outstrip Him and escape Him ﴿فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا﴾ of all things ﴿قَدِيرًا﴾ over them

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا﴾ of sins ﴿مَا تَرَكَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا﴾ i.e. of the earth ﴿مِنْ دَابَّةٍ﴾ a living being that moves upon it ﴿وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ the Day of Resurrection ﴿فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا﴾ and He will recompense them for their deeds, by rewarding the believers and punishing the disbelievers.

daas-irab:44-45.t:
﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسيروا. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and عاقبة is its noun. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of الذين. ﴿وَكانُوا أَشَدَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and كان with its noun and its khabar. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to أشد. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ كان, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِيُعْجِزَهُ﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form, nominative in position, as fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of شيء. ﴿وَلا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ﴾
a defective past verb, its noun omitted. ﴿عَلِيماً قَدِيراً﴾ two khabars of كان; the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُؤاخِذُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative pronoun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَسَبُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿تَرَكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلى ظَهْرِها﴾ both attached to ترك. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi of ترك. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the hāʾ is its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ a ṣifa of أجل, genitive like it, with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb of time [Translator's note: the source says «for what has passed of time» (لما مضى من الزمان), though إذا is normally an adverb for future time] that carries the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective past verb, its noun latent. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾ both attached to the khabar after them. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ the khabar of كان; the clause is the khabar of إنّ.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). The meaning of الحمد is praise and thanks. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), its implied form being "ثابت" (established). ﴿فاطِرِ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of الله. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿جاعِلِ﴾ a second naʿt of الله. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رُسُلًا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿أُولِي﴾ naʿt of رسلا. ﴿أَجْنِحَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَثْنى﴾ naʿt of أجنحة, genitive (majrūr) like it with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَثُلاثَ وَرُباعَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَزِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْخَلْقِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Divine Name is its accusative noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of إنّ. ﴿ما﴾ a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the Divine Name is fāʿil. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿مُمْسِكَ﴾ the noun of لا. ﴿لَها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is conditional. ﴿يُمْسِكْ﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of «ما يفتح الله» in verse 2. ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its two predicates; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:3-5.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute); the clause is resumptive. ﴿اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the discourse is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿خالِقٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of خالق according to its position. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَرْزُقُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of خالق. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is السماء]. ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾ the i'rab of this clause has been given repeatedly. ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and أنّى is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿تُؤْفَكُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional, putting two imperfect verbs in the jussive, the first being the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and the second the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يُكَذِّبُوكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis, the sign of its jussive being the elision of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ﴾ a passive past verb, and رسل is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of رسل. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the Divine Name is genitive by إلى; the two are attached to the verb after them. ﴿تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and الأمور is the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ its i'rab was given just above. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal. ﴿إِنَّ وَعْدَ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقٌّ﴾ khabar. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive لا; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ naʿt of الحياة, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَلا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ﴾ its i'rab has been given. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْغَرُورُ﴾ fāʿil. الغَرور is Satan.

daas-irab:6-7.t: ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) عدوّ. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ khabar. ﴿فَاتَّخِذُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa — so called because it discloses (tufṣiḥu) an implied condition — and an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَدُوًّا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَدْعُوا حِزْبَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness; حزبه is mafʿūl bihi and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِيَكُونُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the wāw is its noun. ﴿مِنْ أَصْحابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿السَّعِيرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of عذاب. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of الذين كفروا. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; الصالحات is its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَأَجْرٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مغفرة. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ naʿt of أجر.

daas-irab:8-9.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and مَن is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the overt fatḥa on its end. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) زيّن. ﴿سُوءُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿عَمَلِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَرَآهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; رآه is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿حَسَناً﴾ second object of رآه. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis, and إنّ, and the Divine Name is its noun. ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ the relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and نفسك is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿حَسَراتٍ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is relative; the two are attached to يصنعون [Translator's note: so in the source; they are normally attached to عليم]. ﴿يَصْنَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْسَلَ الرِّياحَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَتُثِيرُ سَحاباً﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَسُقْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى بَلَدٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿مَيِّتٍ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of بلد. ﴿فَأَحْيَيْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحيينا. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مَوْتِها﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ fronted khabar. ﴿النُّشُورُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾ conditional, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted. ﴿يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ﴾ an imperfect verb; العزة is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿فَلِلَّهِ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the Divine Name is genitive by the lām; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar. ﴿الْعِزَّةَ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: the source prints this word with a fatḥa; in the verse it is العِزَّةُ, nominative]; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الطَّيِّبُ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of الكلم. ﴿وَالْعَمَلُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and العمل is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الصَّالِحُ﴾ naʿt of العمل. ﴿يَرْفَعُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of العمل. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; السيئات is a naʿt of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَكْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿يَبُورُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:11-12.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْواجاً﴾ a past verb and its two objects, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿تَحْمِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أُنْثى﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, fāʿil. ﴿وَلا تَضَعُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِعِلْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿يُعَمَّرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿مُعَمَّرٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَلا يُنْقَصُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ عُمُرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ إنّ, and the demonstrative is in the position of the accusative as its noun. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by على, and the two are attached to the khabar يسير. ﴿يَسِيرٌ﴾ the nominative khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرانِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the alif because it is a dual. ﴿هذا عَذْبٌ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ and عذب is its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فُراتٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of عذب. ﴿سائِغٌ شَرابُهُ﴾ سائغ is a fronted khabar and شرابه a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a second naʿt of عذب. ﴿وَهذا مِلْحٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أُجاجٌ﴾ naʿt of ملح. الأجاج is that which is intensely salty. ﴿وَمِنْ كُلٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿لَحْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿طَرِيًّا﴾ naʿt; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَلْبَسُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt. ﴿وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيهِ مَواخِرَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the ḥāl مواخر. ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being the elision of the nūn; the lām of causation and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to مواخر. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبتغوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the [whole] clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:13-14.t: ﴿يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي النَّهارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيُولِجُ النَّهارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes, and its i'rab is like it. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to الشمس. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لِأَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجري. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ naʿt (adjective) of أجل, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿ذلِكُمُ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, khabar. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ second khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is a third khabar of ربكم [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e., a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلكم]. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and the relative noun is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قِطْمِيرٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَدْعُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the nūn, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is fāʿil and the hāʾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَسْمَعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause has no grammatical position because it is not preceded by the connective fāʾ of the apodosis. ﴿دُعاءَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿سَمِعُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is initial. ﴿مَا﴾ negative. ﴿اسْتَجابُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to the verb after it. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِشِرْكِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the kāf is its fronted mafʿūl bihi and مثل its postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿خَبِيرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra.

daas-irab:15-16.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh); the clause is resumptive. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَراءُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by إلى; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) فقراء. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the Divine Name is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ﴾ two predicates of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional. ﴿يَشَأْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُذْهِبْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent, referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿وَيَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يذهبكم, jussive like it by the elision of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِخَلْقٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأت. ﴿جَدِيدٍ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of خلق.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative, operating like ليس. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative, in the position of the nominative as the noun of ما; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) after them. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and عزيز is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿تَزِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿وازِرَةٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative. ﴿وِزْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُخْرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is conjoined. The meaning is: no sinning soul bears the sin of another soul. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إن is a jussive conditional. ﴿تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the elision of the weak letter, and مثقلة is its fāʿil; المثقلة means one laden with sins. ﴿إِلى حِمْلِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تدع. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُحْمَلْ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ or with the إذا of surprise. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿شَيْءٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ ذا﴾ كان and its khabar; its noun is omitted. ﴿قُرْبى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra in place of the fatḥa owing to impossibility [Translator's note: so in the source; the genitive here is by an implied kasra on the alif]; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its mafʿūl bihi; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and ربهم its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ مَن is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is parenthetical. ﴿تَزَكَّى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis and إنما is restraining and restrained. ﴿يَتَزَكَّى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is «هو», the apodosis; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source, although it has just called the fāʾ of فإنما connective for the apodosis]. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is in the position of the genitive by إلى, and the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:19-24.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negative. ﴿يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمى﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الأعمى; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿الظُّلُماتُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلَا النُّورُ وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, with لا redundant in each conjunction. The meaning of الظلمات is unbelief and النور is faith; the meaning of الظل is the Garden and الحرور is the Fire. ﴿وَما يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْياءُ وَلَا الْأَمْواتُ﴾ the i'rab of the like of it has been given. The living are the believers and the dead are the unbelievers. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Divine Name is its noun. ﴿يُسْمِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative, operating like ليس. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of ما. ﴿بِمُسْمِعٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and مسمع is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar of ما. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of مسمع. ﴿فِي الْقُبُورِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of مَن. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of إنّا. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿بَشِيراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿وَنَذِيراً﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إن is negative. ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ genitive in form and nominative in position, mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿خَلا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أمة.

daas-irab:25-27.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and إن is a jussive conditional. ﴿يُكَذِّبُوكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the elision of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil (agent) and the kāf mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءتهم. ﴿وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتابِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to البينات. ﴿الْمُنِيرِ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the relative noun is its mafʿūl bihi; the clauses are conjoined. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ نَكِيرِ﴾ كان and its noun; its khabar has come before it. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and لم is a jussive particle. ﴿تَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the elision of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ, and the Divine Name is its noun; أنّ with its noun and khabar stands in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً﴾ a past verb, and ماء is its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أنزل; the clause is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثَمَراتٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مُخْتَلِفاً﴾ naʿt of ثمرات, accusative like it. ﴿أَلْوانُها﴾ fāʿil of مختلف. ﴿وَمِنَ الْجِبالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿جُدَدٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِيضٌ﴾ naʿt of جدد. جُدَد is the plural of جُدّة, which is a path in the mountain. ﴿وَحُمْرٌ﴾ conjoined to بيض. ﴿مُخْتَلِفٌ﴾ a second naʿt of جدد. ﴿أَلْوانُها﴾ fāʿil of مختلف. ﴿وَغَرابِيبُ سُودٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and سود is a badal (substitute) of غرابيب, which are intensely black rocks.

daas-irab:28-29.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعامِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الناس. ﴿مُخْتَلِفٌ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَلْوانُهُ﴾ fāʿil (agent) of مختلف. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is genitive by it; the two are attached to a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَخْشَى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْعُلَماءُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ﴾ إنّ, the Divine Name is its noun, and عزيز غفور are its two nominative predicates. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ إنّ, and the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَتْلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كِتابَ اللَّهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, in construct with the Divine Name. ﴿وَأَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَنْفَقُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ composed of two words, the preposition مِن and the relative ما; the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿سِرًّا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَعَلانِيَةً﴾ conjoined. ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿تِجارَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَنْ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba). ﴿تَبُورَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is a naʿt of تجارة.

daas-irab:30-32.t: ﴿لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ﴾ the lām is the lām of outcome (lām al-ṣayrūra) or the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), and يوفّيهم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the lām and what follows it are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تبور; the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أُجُورَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَزِيدَهُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ﴾ إنّ and its noun, and غفور شكور are its two predicates. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوحينا. ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾ هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and الحق is the khabar (predicate) of الذي; or هو الحق is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the khabar of الذي. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿لِما﴾ the lām is a preposition and ما is relative; the two are attached to مصدّقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما. ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name is the noun of إنّ. ﴿بِعِبادِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبير, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾ two predicates of إنّ, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَوْرَثْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اصْطَفَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is for detailing (tafrīʿ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar of ظالم. ﴿ظالِمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظالم. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ﴾ conjoined to the preceding فمنهم ظالم. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ سابِقٌ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿بِالْخَيْراتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سابق. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun. ﴿الْفَضْلُ﴾ the khabar of ذلك. ﴿الْكَبِيرُ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of فضل.

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَدْخُلُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿يُحَلَّوْنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿أَساوِرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of يحلّون. ﴿مِنْ ذَهَبٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أساور. ﴿وَلُؤْلُؤاً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أساور. ﴿وَلِباسُهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لباسهم is mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَرِيرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, naʿt of الله. ﴿أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ﴾ a past verb; الحزن is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); عنّا is attached to the verb before it; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّنا﴾ إنّ and its noun, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and two predicates of إنّ [Translator's note: the source prints «لأن», a misprint for «لإنّ»]; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ badal (substitute) of the preceding الذي. ﴿أَحَلَّنا دارَ﴾ a past verb and its two objects, the fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْمُقامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أحلّنا. ﴿لا يَمَسُّنا﴾ لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, and نا is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿نَصَبٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَلا يَمَسُّنا فِيها لُغُوبٌ﴾ conjoined to the preceding [clause of the] verse, and its i'rab is like its i'rab.

daas-irab:36-37.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿نارُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa instead of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause لهم نار is the khabar of الذين. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يُقْضى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir) [Translator's note: so in the source; with a passive verb it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)]. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَيَمُوتُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation, the sign of its accusative being the elision of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لا يقضى عليهم. ﴿مِنْ عَذابِها﴾ مِن is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and عذابها is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, nāʾib fāʿil of يخفّف. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by the kāf; the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَفُورٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَصْطَرِخُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative, with an omitted vocative particle, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يقولون ربنا" (they say: Our Lord). ﴿أَخْرِجْنا﴾ a verb of supplication; نا is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿نَعْمَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); its fāʿil is latent. ﴿صالِحاً﴾ naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, its implied form being "عملا صالحا" (righteous deeds). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of نعمل. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿نَعْمَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent [Translator's note: the source prints this second word with a sukūn; in the verse it is نَعْمَلُ, nominative, as the analysis says]; the clause is the khabar of كنّا. ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for reproachful interrogation (istifhām tawbīkhī), the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and inversion (to the past). ﴿نُعَمِّرْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is «نحن»; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تذكّر. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil of تذكّر; the clause is a naʿt of ما. ﴿تَذَكَّرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَجاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and النذير is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the elision of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is causal and ما is negative, operating like ليس. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a redundant preposition [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the Quranic word is مِنْ]. ﴿نَصِيرٍ﴾ the noun of ما. It is also permissible to parse ما as negative [only], with للظالمين attached to the fronted khabar and نذير as mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is نصير].

daas-irab:38-40.t:
﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾
the Divine Name is the noun of إنّ. ﴿عالِمُ﴾
the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْبِ﴾
muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾
muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾
conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾
إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾
the khabar of إنّ. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾
a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾
muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the relative noun, khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَكُمْ خَلائِفَ﴾ a past verb and its two objects, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and مَن is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of مَن. ﴿فَعَلَيْهِ﴾ the fāʾ is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿كُفْرُهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يَزِيدُ الْكافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ﴾
an imperfect verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَقْتاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of يزيد. ﴿وَلا يَزِيدُ الْكافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَساراً﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes, and its i'rab is like its i'rab. ﴿قُلْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ شُرَكاءَكُمُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of شركاء, in the position of the accusative. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَرُونِي﴾ an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil and the yāʾ its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is parenthetical. ﴿ماذا﴾ ما is interrogative, mubtadaʾ, and ذا is its khabar; the clause is the second object of أروني. ﴿خَلَقُوا﴾ the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿شِرْكٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شرك. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿آتَيْناهُمْ كِتاباً﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is its first object and كتابا its second object. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ a conjunction, and هم is a pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of بيّنة. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ badal (substitute) of part for whole, from الظالمون. ﴿بَعْضاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿غُرُوراً﴾ الغرور is falsehood, namely their worship; غرورا is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).

daas-irab:41-43.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the Divine Name is the noun of إنّ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُمْسِكُ السَّماواتِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a subjunctive particle (nāṣiba) [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the Quranic word is أَنْ]. ﴿تَزُولا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the clause تزولا is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, or as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e., «خشية أن تزولا» (for fear that they should cease). ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the one that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿زالَتا﴾ a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle of negation [Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the Quranic word is the negative إِنْ]. ﴿أَمْسَكَهُما﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, fāʿil of أمسك. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿كانَ حَلِيماً غَفُوراً﴾ كان and its two predicates; as for its noun, it is omitted; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَأَقْسَمُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name is genitive by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to أقسموا. ﴿جَهْدَ﴾ in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath and إن is conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its postponed fāʿil; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position [Translator's note: so in the source; this clause is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the response to the oath is ليكوننّ]. ﴿لَيَكُونُنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the omitted oath; يكوننّ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was elided owing to the dislike of a succession of identical letters, and the elided wāw is its noun. ﴿أَهْدى﴾ khabar, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; the oath clause has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ إِحْدَى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb أهدى [Translator's note: so in the source; أهدى is an elative noun]. ﴿الْأُمَمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. Those meant by «أقسموا» are the unbelievers of Mecca; they said that if Allah sent a prophet among them they would be better guided than the Jews and the Christians, but they turned away when he came to them. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is an adverb of time meaning «حين» (when), in the position of the accusative as an adverb. ﴿جاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ﴾ a past verb; نذير is its postponed fāʿil and the hāʾ its fronted mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿زادَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نُفُوراً﴾ second object of زادهم. ﴿اسْتِكْباراً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what precedes them. ﴿وَمَكْرَ﴾ conjoined to استكبارا, and accusative like it. ﴿السَّيِّئِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿السَّيِّئِ﴾ naʿt (adjective) of مكر. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِأَهْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يحيق. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and هل is an interrogative particle. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿سُنَّتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the verb before it. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لن is a subjunctive particle. ﴿تَجِدَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by لن, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِسُنَّتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبديلا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَبْدِيلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تجد. ﴿وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا﴾ its i'rab is clear; the clause is conjoined.

farraa:1-1.t: His saying: ﴿يَزِيدُ فِي ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ﴾: this concerns the wings that He gave to Gabriel and Michael; He means the increase in wings.

farraa:2-2.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلاَ مُرْسِلَ لَهُ﴾: He did not say لهَا ("for it", fem.), though He said before that ﴿مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلاَ مُمْسِكَ لَهَا﴾; the feminine in (لهَا) was because الرحمة (mercy) appears overtly. Had He said فلا مُمسكَ له it would have been permissible, because the hāʾ refers only to (ما). And had it been said in the second فلا مرسل لها, the pronoun referring to الرحمة, it would have been permissible; but since الرحمة dropped out of the second, it was made masculine with reference to (ما).

farraa:3-3.t:
His saying: ﴿ٱذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: wherever in the Qurʾān His saying ﴿ٱذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ occurs, its meaning is: keep [it] in mind, as you say: اذكر أيادِىّ عنك ("remember my favours to you"), i.e. keep them in mind.
His saying: ﴿هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ﴾ is read ﴿غيرُ﴾ and ﴿غيرِ﴾. Shaqīq ibn Salama read it (غَيْرِ), and that is the proper construction. ʿĀṣim read it (هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ}. Whoever puts it in the genitive makes (غير) a naʿt (adjective) of الخالق. Whoever makes it nominative says: I meant إلاّ (except) by غير; since what follows (إلاّ) is nominative [here], I put the nominative of what follows (إلاّ) on (غير), as you say: ما قام من أحدٍ إلاَّ أبوك (no one stood except your father). All are good. Had you made (غير) accusative when إلاّ is meant by it, it would have been correct.
The Arabs say ما أتانى أحد غَيْرَك (no one came to me other than you), and the nominative is more common, because (إلا) is fitting in its place.

farraa:8-8.t: His saying: ﴿أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوۤءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَآهُ حَسَناً﴾: He says: his deeds were made confusing to him, so that he saw his bad as good. Then He said ﴿فَلاَ تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ﴾, so the answer was made to follow with His saying ﴿فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَآءُ﴾, and it sufficed to make the answer follow with the second phrase, because it suffices for the answer to the first. Had the whole answer been brought out, it would have been: أفمن زين له سوءُ عَمله ذهبت نفسُك ("is one whose evil deed has been made attractive to him [such that] your soul has gone out [in grief]?") or تذهب نفسُك; because His saying ﴿فَلاَ تَذْهَبْ﴾ is a prohibition that indicates that what is prohibited has already occurred at the start of the sentence. Similar in ordinary speech is: إذا غضبت فلا تقتل (when you are angry, do not kill), as though he used to kill in anger, and was forbidden that. The readers agree on ﴿تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ﴾; some have reported from Abū Jaʿfar al-Madanī (فلا تُذْهِبْ نفسَك عليهم) ("do not destroy yourself over them"). All are correct.

farraa:10-10.t:
His saying: ﴿مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعاً﴾: as for (العزَّة), its meaning is: whoever wants knowledge of might, and to whom it belongs — it belongs to Allah entirely, i.e. every kind of might belongs to Allah.
His saying: ﴿إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ﴾: the readers agree on ﴿الكَلِم﴾, except Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, who read (الكلام الطيِّب). All are good, and ﴿الكَلِم﴾ is better, because it is kalima and kalim. His saying ﴿الكلمات﴾ in many places in the Qurʾān indicates that الكلم is better. The Arabs say kalima and kalim; as for al-kalām, it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).
The poet said:
مالكِ تَرْغين ولا يَرْغُو الخَلِفْ * وَتضْجَرين والمطىّ مُعترِف
(What is the matter with you, groaning, when the pregnant camels do not groan, and complaining, when the riding beasts endure patiently?)
He formed the plural of al-khalifa by dropping the hāʾ [i.e. tāʾ marbūṭa], as one says shajara and shajar.
His saying: ﴿وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ﴾, i.e. it raises the good words. He says: good speech is accepted when there is righteous action with it. And had it been said ﴿والعَمَلَ الصَّالحَ﴾ in the accusative, with the meaning "Allah raises the righteous deed", the meaning would then be: Allah raises ﴿ٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّالِحُ﴾; and with this meaning the nominative is also permissible, just as the accusative was permissible because of the wāw at its beginning.

farraa:11-11.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ﴾: He says: no life is lengthened, nor is [anything] diminished from his life — He means another, not the first, and then He referred to him by the hāʾ [pronoun] as though he were the first.
Similar in ordinary speech: عندى درهم ونصفه (I have a dirham and half of it), meaning half of another. It was permissible to refer to it by the hāʾ, because the wording of the second may appear like the wording of the first, so it is referred to as the first is referred to.
There is another view about it: ﴿وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلاَ يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ﴾: He says: when night and day pass over him, they diminish his life; and the hāʾ in this meaning is for the first and not for another, because the meaning is: nothing is lengthened and nothing goes from it but that it is counted in a record. Both are good, and the first seems closer to correctness.

farraa:12-12.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْماً طَرِيّاً﴾: He means from both seas: the salt and the fresh. ﴿وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً﴾: from the salt, not the fresh.
His saying: ﴿وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ﴾: their makhr is their cleaving of the water when they pass through it; the singular is mākhira.

farraa:18-18.t: His saying: ﴿وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا﴾: He says: if one [soul] laden with sins that have weighed it down calls [others] to its sins, so that some of the sins may be carried for it, it will not find that, even if the one it calls is a father or a son. That is His saying: ﴿وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ﴾. Had it been ﴿ذو قربى﴾, it would have been permissible, because [the relative] has not been mentioned, so it becomes indefinite. Whoever makes it nominative implies nothing in (كان), so it becomes like His saying (وَإِنْ كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ}; whoever makes it accusative implies [a subject]. In the reading of Ubayy it is (وَإِنْ كَانَ ذَا عُسْرَةٍ) on that basis. He made ﴿مُثْقَلَةٌ﴾ feminine only with reference to the creature (dābba) or the soul (nafs), which both express male and female; as He said ﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ المُوْتِ﴾, for male and female.

farraa:19-19.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَوِي ٱلأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ﴾: the blind here is the unbeliever, and the seeing is the believer.

farraa:20-20.t: His saying: ﴿وَلاَ ٱلظُّلُمَاتُ وَلاَ ٱلنُّورُ﴾: the darknesses: unbelief; the light: faith.

farraa:21-21.t: His saying: ﴿وَلاَ ٱلظِّلُّ وَلاَ ٱلْحَرُورُ﴾: the shade: the Garden; the scorching heat: the Fire.

farraa:22-22.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا يَسْتَوِي ٱلأَحْيَآءُ وَلاَ ٱلأَمْوَاتُ﴾: the living: the believers; the dead: the unbelievers.

farraa:27-27.t: His saying: ﴿جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ﴾: the streaks and tracks in the mountains like veins, white, black and red; the singular is judda.

farraa:28-28.t: His saying: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ belongs to the ṣila (continuation) of الثمرات and the diversity of their colours, i.e. among people and others, like the first. Then He began afresh and said: ﴿إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَاءُ﴾.

farraa:29-29.t: His saying: ﴿يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ﴾ is the answer to His saying ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلاَةَ﴾: ﴿أولئكَ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ﴾; so ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ is the answer [i.e. the khabar (predicate)] to the beginning of the speech.

farraa:32-32.t: His saying: ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ﴾: this is the unbeliever; ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مُّقْتَصِدٌ﴾: these are the People of the Right; ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِٱلْخَيْرَاتِ﴾. The interpretation of this agrees with the interpretation of the one in [Sūrat] al-Wāqiʿa. The Companions of the Right (aṣḥāb al-maymana) are those who take the middle course; it is also said: they are the [deceased] children. The Companions of the Left (aṣḥāb al-mashʾama) are the unbelievers, and al-mashʾama is the Fire. "And the foremost, the foremost": these are the people of the highest degrees; those are the ones brought near, in the Gardens of ʿAdn.

farraa:33-33.t: His saying: ﴿جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ﴾: the meaning of ʿadn is residing in it; عَدَن بالموضع (he resided in the place).

farraa:34-34.t: His saying: ﴿أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ﴾: the grief for livelihood and the cares of this world. It is also said: the grief is the grief of death. It is also said: the grief over the Garden and the Fire — "we do not know to which of the two we will go."

farraa:35-35.t:
His saying: ﴿دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ﴾: this is residing (iqāma). Al-maqāma is the gathering place in which one stands; the [word for] gathering place has fatḥa and nothing else; as the poet said:
يومَان يومُ مقاماتٍ وَأنديَة * ويومُ سير إلى الأعداءِ تأْويبِ
(Two days: a day of gatherings and assemblies, and a day of journeying against the enemies, travelling all day.)
Al-Sulamī read (لَغُوب) [with fatḥa], as though he made it that which causes weariness, like lagūb; and the [usual] word is lughūb, with ḍamma on the lām; al-lughūb is exhaustion.

farraa:37-37.t: His saying: ﴿وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ﴾: He means Muḥammad ﷺ. Grey hair has also been mentioned [as the warner].

farraa:40-40.t: His saying: ﴿أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلأَرْضِ﴾, i.e. they did not create anything in the earth. Then He said: ﴿أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ﴾, i.e. in their creation, i.e. did they help Him in creating them?

farraa:41-41.t:
His saying: ﴿وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ﴾ is equivalent to His saying "and if they were to cease"; ﴿إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا﴾: (إنْ) has the meaning of (ما) (not). It is equivalent to His saying ﴿وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحاً فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرّاً لَظَلُّوا مِنْ بَعْدِه﴾.
